title: How Israel’s genocide in Gaza pulled Britons into the Palestine movement
description: Britons are risking freedom and reputations to stand with Palestinians and challenge government policy.

title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.

title: How a Shadow Economy in Asia Is Keeping Iranian Oil Flowing
description: Companies continue to service a “dark fleet” of Iranian tankers in waters off Malaysia in spite of Washington’s threat to target them.

title: How a Small Business Got Entangled in U.S. Sanctions on Iranian Oil
description: The case of a small Malaysian shipping agency illustrates the challenges Washington faces in its effort to stanch the flow of Iranian oil.

title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
description: Fears that the death may have been caused by pneumonic plague has prompted calls for more transparency from Russia.

title: Malawians Struggle to Survive After Fleeing Anti-Immigrant Violence
description: Anti-immigrant violence in South Africa has forced tens of thousands to return to Malawi, severing badly needed cash flows and leaving families hungry.

title: Zelensky condemns 'vile' large-scale Russian attacks that killed 24
description: Rescue workers are continuing a search for residents after an apartment building in Pryluky was destroyed.

title: The School Near Paris That Shows Why French Students Are Protesting
description: Angered by poor classroom conditions, students at Paul Éluard High School in a suburb of the capital were among the first to blockade their campus during an ongoing round of unrest.

title: For Twin Brothers Abducted in the Oct. 7 Attacks, Adjusting to Freedom Is a New Challenge
description: Gali and Ziv Berman were taken hostage when their kibbutz was attacked on Oct. 7, 2023. They were freed a year ago but are still adjusting to freedom and trying to rebuild their lives.

title: Ukraine Claws Back Land in the Donbas, Thwarting a Russian Push
description: Moscow says its capture of the region is inevitable. But Kyiv has so far stymied Russian efforts to encircle Ukrainian “fortress belt” cities.

title: Russia Says It Found No ‘Emergency’ in Plague Lab
description: New information around the death of a lab worker, including a statement that she had been vaccinated against the plague, came as U.S. officials demanded more data.
